article.title: Denver takes on Toronto in non-conference play
article.linkText: Denver takes on Toronto in non-conference play
article.story: Toronto Raptors (3-3, fifth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Denver Nuggets (3-3, 10th in the Western Conference) Denver; Wednesday, 9 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Denver faces Toronto in non-conference action. Denver finished 54-28 overall with a 28-13 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Nuggets gave up 116.9 points per game while committing 19.1 fouls last season. Toronto went 46-36 overall with a 22-19 record on the road last season. The Raptors gave up 111.8 points per game while committing 20.9 fouls last season. INJURIES: Nuggets: Spencer Jones: out (hamstring), Julian Strawther: out (knee). Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: out (foot), Jakob Poeltl: out (shoulder). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
